g.text: Circular shells at 550 km with satellites spread evenly in orbit position and node (Monte Carlo); a satellite is in view above 25° elevation. (b) Linear programme:
choose the number of satellites in each shell to minimise the total while meeting an illustrative requirement of 12 satellites in view at 25–50° latitude, 4
elsewhere up to 60° and 2 up to 75°.
